# VFDistiller

Canonical repository: https://github.com/biotec-line/VFDistiller
Organization: https://github.com/biotec-line
Ecosystem: https://github.com/open-bricks
License: AGPL-3.0-or-later
Primary language: Python
UI stack: Windows-first desktop GUI with ttkbootstrap/Tk, Web Companion PWA, optional PyInstaller build
Also known as: Variant Fusion Distiller
Version: 17.0.1
Last-checked: 2026-09-16
Test Status: 142 passed, 10 subtests passed (100% green)

## Summary

VFDistiller is a local-first bioinformatics desktop application for
research-grade genetic variant data. It imports, converts, filters, annotates,
and exports VCF, gVCF, 23andMe raw text, and FASTA files on the user's own
machine. The project is intended for bioinformatics research, teaching, and
software development only.

VFDistiller is not a medical device, not CE-IVD certified, and not intended for
clinical diagnosis, prognosis, therapy recommendations, or consumer health
deciding. ClinSig and variant-impact values shown in the application are
third-party database annotations for research orientation, not clinical
assessments.

## Target Personas

- `[PERSONA-01]` Clinical Geneticists & Molecular Pathologists (Research & Academic Pathology)
- `[PERSONA-02]` Bioinformatics Core Facility Engineers & Pipeline Developers
- `[PERSONA-03]` Rare Disease Researchers & Academic Genomic Analysts
- `[PERSONA-04]` Privacy-Conscious Medical Data Stewards & Offline Clinical Lab IT

## Comparative Matrix vs. Alternatives

VFDistiller maps against 4 domain alternatives (Unix Shell Pipelines, Cloud Variant Portals, IGV Desktop, General Annotation Engines) across 10 technical dimensions governed by `INV-LOCAL-01` to `INV-SLA-10`:
1. `INV-LOCAL-01`: 100% Local-First & Zero Egress (no mandatory cloud upload)
2. `INV-PRIVACY-02`: Locus & rsID Log Redaction (`redact_for_logfile` protects genomic privacy)
3. `INV-INSPECT-03`: Interactive Windows GUI & PWA Companion (visual filtering & inspection)
4. `INV-CONVERT-04`: Multi-Format Ingestion (VCF v4.2, gVCF, 23andMe, FASTA without Unix tools)
5. `INV-OFFLINE-05`: Offline Allele Frequency Engine (gnomAD LightDB SQLite)
6. `INV-ACCEL-06`: Optional Cython Hotpath (up to 5x acceleration with pure-Python fallback)
7. `INV-EXPORT-07`: Multi-Format Report Export (preserved FORMAT metrics; VCF, CSV, Excel, PDF)
8. `INV-UNPRIV-08`: Unprivileged User-Mode Operation (`RunAsInvoker`, zero admin elevation)
9. `INV-COMPLY-09`: Explicit RUO Boundary (strict Research Use Only, IVDR EU 2017/746 demarcation)
10. `INV-SLA-10`: Open-Source Governance & 48h Security SLA (AGPL-3.0, 48h response SLA)

## Privacy Notes

The app is local-first. Raw genetic files, converted VCFs, genome references,
SQLite caches, local settings, logs, API keys, and downloaded annotation
databases are excluded from the public repository and should remain on the
user's machine. Locus coordinates and rsIDs are automatically redacted from
persistent log files.
